final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaingb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaingb / m.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean FROM g, m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (g.avg_remaingb / m.mean_avg) IS NULL, ratio_to_mean DESC LIMIT 10
